story.value: Krypton's name comes from the Greek word kryptos, meaning hidden.
Krypton was discovered in 1898 by Scottish chemist William Ramsay and English chemist Morris Travers while they were studying liquefied air.
Ramsay and Travers found krypton in what was left after liquid air had nearly boiled away.

uses.value: Krypton is used in some types of photographic flashes for high-speed photography.
Some fluorescent light bulbs are filled with a mixture of krypton and argon gases.
Krypton gas is combined with other gases to make glowing signs that give off a greenish-yellow light.
